caption: Specificity checks of the reply-start decision coordinate swap (rank 1, layers 16 to 63, bee-helper and crow-helper models, run 1), in the order they ran. Cell = the largest single random-direction control's shift toward the donor as a percentage of the real edit's shift (test 1: max of 10 per-layer-matched nulls; test 2: max of 6 random controls; test 3: max of the 3 sustained random clamps at about 1.8 times the edit's cumulative size; tests 4 and 5: max of 3 random clamps at 1.0 times). Row label = random-edit cumulative state offset relative to the edit at layers 44 to 63 (test 2 measured afterwards by the overnight check; test 1 saved no activations). Tests 1 to 4: 64 scripts from 5 old scenarios; test 5: 61 held-out scenarios. Test 1 forced aside, tests 2 to 5 free replies; tests 1 and 2 on the rival share among habit-bearing replies, tests 3 to 5 on each run's frozen scale (unconditional rival rate in 4 and 5). Frozen verdicts: Test 1: Toward the rival, bee-helper: passes; Toward the rival, crow-helper: passes; Away from the rival, bee-helper: passes; Away from the rival, crow-helper: passes | Test 2: Toward the rival, bee-helper: passes; Toward the rival, crow-helper: passes; Away from the rival, bee-helper: passes; Away from the rival, crow-helper: passes | Test 3: Toward the rival, bee-helper: passes; Toward the rival, crow-helper: random edits also move it; Away from the rival, bee-helper: random edits also move it; Away from the rival, crow-helper: random edits also move it | Test 4: Away from the rival, bee-helper: passes; Away from the rival, crow-helper: partly (random edits remove some) | Test 5: Toward the rival, bee-helper: passes; Toward the rival, crow-helper: passes; Away from the rival, bee-helper: partly (random edits remove some); Away from the rival, crow-helper: partly (random edits remove some). The early pass of removal came from controls 0.17 times the edit's size.
